title: Local Entropy Fluctuations for Black-Box LLM-Generated Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zero-shot detection of machine-generated text is vital for mitigating the risks of large language models (LLMs) misuse. While the state-of-the-art dual-model detectors and resampling-based detectors outperform single-model statistical detectors on unprompted continuations, they suffer a catastrophic breakdown on instruction-conditioned text in the black-box setting, where the source model is unknown. We analyze this failure and trace it to poor prompt conditioning for resampling-based methods and diminished cross-model discrepancy for dual-model detectors. Motivated by recent studies that human writing maintains a steady, uniform information flow, whereas machine-generated text exhibits sharp, localized entropy fluctuations, we propose a new metric, the Relative Peak Prominence Rate (RelPPR) to capture this structural contrast along the entropy trajectory and further leverage it as a signal for LLM-generated text detection. translated_title: 基于局部熵波动的黑盒大语言模型生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 零样本机器生成文本检测对于缓解大语言模型（LLM）滥用风险至关重要。尽管最先进的双模型检测器和基于重采样的检测器在无提示续写文本上的表现优于单模型统计检测器，但在黑盒设置（即源模型未知）下，它们在指令条件生成的文本上会遭遇灾难性失效。我们分析了这一失效现象，并将其根源归结为基于重采样的方法在提示条件下表现不佳，以及双模型检测器跨模型差异的减弱。受近期研究启发现象的启发——人类写作保持稳定、均匀的信息流，而机器生成的文本则呈现出尖锐的局部熵波动——我们提出了一种新指标：相对峰值显著率，用以捕捉熵轨迹上的这种结构性对比，并进一步将其作为LLM生成文本检测的信号。大量实验……
tldr: 该论文提出新指标“相对峰值显著率”，利用人类写作信息流均匀而机器生成文本存在尖锐局部熵波动这一结构性差异，解决了黑盒场景下现有检测器在指令条件文本上灾难性失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new metric, Relative Peak Prominence Rate (RelPPR), which exploits the structural contrast that human writing maintains a steady information flow while machine-generated text exhibits sharp local entropy fluctuations, enabling robust black-box detection of LLM-generated instruction-conditioned text where existing detectors catastrophically fail.
